cases.title: slugify
cases.objective: Add src/slugify.js exporting slugify(text): lower-case the text, replace every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 with a single '-', and remove leading and trailing '-'. Add test/slugify.test.js with node:test cases for spaces, punctuation and leading or trailing symbols.
cases.acceptanceCriteria: slugify('  Hello, World! ') returns 'hello-world', and node --test passes.

cases.title: titleCase
cases.objective: Add src/title-case.js exporting titleCase(text): upper-case the first letter of every word from src/words.js and lower-case the rest, joining the words with single spaces. Add test/title-case.test.js.
cases.acceptanceCriteria: titleCase('hELLO   wORLD') returns 'Hello World', and node --test passes.

cases.title: wordCount
cases.objective: Add src/word-count.js exporting wordCount(text): the number of words, using words() from src/words.js. Add test/word-count.test.js, including the empty string.
cases.acceptanceCriteria: wordCount('') is 0, wordCount(' a b  c ') is 3, and node --test passes.

cases.title: truncate
cases.objective: Add src/truncate.js exporting truncate(text, max): the text unchanged when it has at most max characters, otherwise its first max - 1 characters followed by '…'. Add test/truncate.test.js.
cases.acceptanceCriteria: truncate('abcdef', 4) returns 'abc…', truncate('abc', 4) returns 'abc', and node --test passes.

cases.title: document the library
cases.objective: Add a Usage section to README.md with one line and one example for each of words, slugify, titleCase, wordCount and truncate.
cases.acceptanceCriteria: README.md documents all five functions, and node --test passes.
